turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. The zero went into the gradebook before anyone called me, and my son found out on his phone in the middle of class. Withdraw it.
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
Okay. You asked for this meeting, so you can start. On what basis did you give my son a zero?
I have to say, I can tell you're an amazing mother. Owen is lucky to have someone fight for him like this.
Don't manage me, Hale. I asked you on what basis you gave my son a zero.
Honestly, I wish more parents cared as much as you do.
That's the second compliment and still no answer. I'm not here to be thanked, Hale, so what is your basis for the zero?
So I'm sure we can work this out together.
"Work this out together." Okay. Then start by telling me what you have, because so far I've heard three sentences and no basis. I have until 4:40.
